name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Hybrid.stat_hops_carry
title: Statistical hops carry the decryptor's advantage: total >= 1 - delta - |C| * eps
statement: For laws D 0, ..., D T on words, a set C of hop indices and a machine A: if A's advantage between D 0 and D T is at least 1 - delta, and A's advantage on each hop (D i, D (i+1)) with i in C is at most eps in absolute value, then the sum over the hops i < T not in C of A's absolute advantage is at least 1 - delta - |C| * eps. With A the decryptor on a true statement and C the hops justified by a statement-independent assumption, this is the counting step of the SZK barrier for witness encryption (notes pq-we-hybrid-count-barrier, pq-we-gap-structure-routes).
